verdict.rationale: Recurly exposes a full REST API and client libraries covering subscription changes, credits, and invoices (recurly-docs-1, -2, -9, -13), which could technically be driven by an agent. However, the only AI-specific surface documented, Recurly Compass MCP, is explicitly a documentation/knowledge connector for AI dev tools, not an operational interface for executing billing actions (recurly-docs-12, recurly-probe-2), and there is no evidence of scoped/restricted API keys or permission models designed for autonomous agent use. Missing for 10: an agent-oriented action interface (e.g., MCP server or agent SDK) that can actually invoke billing operations, and documentation of scoped/least-privilege API credentials for agent access.
